// Snapshot generator for the Postgres upgrade leg. Not compiled here (.txt under
// testdata); regen.sh copies it into internal/storage of a checkout of an old release, with the
// shared state file, and runs it against that release's own core on Postgres.
// Output: <W6_OUT>/snapshot.sql and <W6_OUT>/manifest.json. See ../README.md.
package storage

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	_ "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/stdlib"

	"github.com/keyorixhq/keyorix/internal/config"
	"github.com/keyorixhq/keyorix/internal/core"
	corestorage "github.com/keyorixhq/keyorix/internal/core/storage"
	"github.com/keyorixhq/keyorix/internal/encryption"
	"github.com/keyorixhq/keyorix/internal/i18n"
	"github.com/keyorixhq/keyorix/internal/storage/models"
)

const w6Passphrase = "upgrade-fuzz-passphrase-v1"

// The SQLite leg validated ugModel on 40 seeds; here a probe costs several round
// trips to the server, so fewer seeds and a stride of the probes.
const (
	w6ModelSeeds  = 3
	w6ProbeStride = 7
)

type w6Verdict struct {
	User    uint   `json:"user"`
	Perm    string `json:"perm"`
	Project uint   `json:"project"`
	Env     uint   `json:"env"`
	Allow   bool   `json:"allow"`
}

type w6Version struct {
	Version int    `json:"version"`
	Value   string `json:"value"`
}

type w6Secret struct {
	ID        uint        `json:"id"`
	ProjectID uint        `json:"project_id"`
	Versions  []w6Version `json:"versions"`
}

type w6Manifest struct {
	SourceTag   string      `json:"source_tag"`
	Passphrase  string      `json:"passphrase"`
	Generator   string      `json:"generator"`
	Backend     string      `json:"backend"`
	ModelSeeds  int         `json:"model_seeds"`
	ModelProbes int         `json:"model_probes"`
	Secrets     []w6Secret  `json:"secrets"`
	Verdicts    []w6Verdict `json:"verdicts"`
}

var w6Word = regexp.MustCompile(`[^a-z0-9_]+`)

func w6DSN(base, db string) string {
	if strings.HasPrefix(base, "postgres://") || strings.HasPrefix(base, "postgresql://") {
		u, err := url.Parse(base)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		u.Path = "/" + db
		return u.String()
	}
	re := regexp.MustCompile(`dbname=\S+`)
	if re.MatchString(base) {
		return re.ReplaceAllString(base, "dbname="+db)
	}
	return base + " dbname=" + db
}

func w6Copy(t *testing.T, src, dst string) {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := os.ReadFile(src)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(dst, b, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func w6Config(dsn string) *config.Config {
	return &config.Config{Storage: config.StorageConfig{
		Type:       "postgres",
		Database:   config.DatabaseConfig{DSN: dsn},
		Encryption: config.EncryptionConfig{Enabled: true, DEKPath: "dek.key", SaltPath: "kek.salt"},
	}}
}

func w6Close(st corestorage.Storage) {
	if c, ok := st.(interface{ Close() error }); ok {
		_ = c.Close()
	}
}

// w6Open opens a plain handle for one database.
func w6Open(t *testing.T, dsn string) *sql.DB {
	t.Helper()
	db, err := sql.Open("pgx", dsn)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	db.SetMaxOpenConns(2)
	return db
}

func w6Exec(t *testing.T, db *sql.DB, q string) {
	t.Helper()
	if _, err := db.Exec(q); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s: %v", q, err)
	}
}

func TestW6GenPGSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	// w6_gen.conf (three lines: tag, output directory, key directory) sits next to
	// this file in the checkout; regen.sh writes it.
	confText, err := os.ReadFile("w6_gen.conf")
	if err != nil {
		t.Skip("w6_gen.conf missing; regen.sh writes it")
	}
	conf := strings.Fields(string(confText))
	base := os.Getenv("KEYORIX_TEST_PG_DSN")
	if len(conf) != 3 || base == "" {
		t.Fatal("w6_gen.conf must hold tag, output dir, key dir and KEYORIX_TEST_PG_DSN must be set")
	}
	tag, out, keys := conf[0], conf[1], conf[2]
	if err := i18n.InitializeForTesting(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	slug := w6Word.ReplaceAllString(strings.ToLower(tag), "_")
	name := "w6_gen_" + slug
	admin := w6Open(t, base)
	defer func() { _ = admin.Close() }()
	w6Exec(t, admin, "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS "+name+" WITH (FORCE)")
	w6Exec(t, admin, "CREATE DATABASE "+name)
	defer func() { w6Exec(t, admin, "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS "+name+" WITH (FORCE)") }()
	dsn := w6DSN(base, name)

	keyDir := t.TempDir()
	for _, f := range []string{"dek.key", "kek.salt"} {
		w6Copy(t, filepath.Join(keys, f), filepath.Join(keyDir, f))
	}
	enc := encryption.NewService(&config.EncryptionConfig{Enabled: true, DEKPath: "dek.key", SaltPath: "kek.salt"}, keyDir)
	if err := enc.Initialize(w6Passphrase); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	st, err := NewStorageFactory().CreateStorage(w6Config(dsn))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("old release's own CreateStorage on Postgres: %v", err)
	}
	c := core.NewKeyorixCore(st)
	c.SetAuthEncryptor(enc)
	c.SetSecretValueEncryptor(enc)
	c.SetBootstrapToken("w6-bootstrap-token")
	res, err := c.BootstrapSystem(ctx, &core.BootstrapRequest{Username: "admin", Email: "admin@example.com", Password: "W6-Initial-Password-1!", DisplayName: "Admin", Token: "w6-bootstrap-token"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("bootstrap: %v", err)
	}
	adminID := res.User.ID
	alice, err := c.CreateUser(ctx, &core.CreateUserRequest{Username: "alice", Email: "alice@example.com", DisplayName: "Alice", Password: "W6-Initial-Password-1!"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create alice: %v", err)
	}
	bob, err := c.CreateUser(ctx, &core.CreateUserRequest{Username: "bob", Email: "bob@example.com", DisplayName: "Bob", Password: "W6-Initial-Password-1!"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create bob: %v", err)
	}
	second, err := c.CreateProject(ctx, "second", "second project")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create project: %v", err)
	}
	prod2, err := c.CreateEnvironment(ctx, second.ID, "prod2")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create env: %v", err)
	}
	raw := w6Open(t, dsn)
	defer func() { _ = raw.Close() }()
	roleID := func(n string) uint {
		var id uint
		if err := raw.QueryRow("SELECT id FROM roles WHERE name = $1", n).Scan(&id); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("role %s: %v", n, err)
		}
		return id
	}
	if err := w6AssignUserRole(c, ctx, adminID, alice.ID, roleID("viewer"), core.Scope{ProjectID: 1}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("assign alice: %v", err)
	}
	if err := w6AssignUserRole(c, ctx, adminID, bob.ID, roleID("editor"), core.Scope{ProjectID: second.ID, EnvironmentID: prod2.ID}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("assign bob: %v", err)
	}
	g, err := c.CreateGroup(ctx, adminID, &core.CreateGroupRequest{Name: "ops-team", Description: "snapshot group"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create group: %v", err)
	}
	if err := w6AddGlobal(c, ctx, adminID, bob.ID, g.ID); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("add member: %v", err)
	}
	if err := w6AssignGroupRole(c, ctx, adminID, g.ID, roleID("project_viewer"), core.Scope{ProjectID: 1}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("assign group: %v", err)
	}

	mf := w6Manifest{SourceTag: tag, Passphrase: w6Passphrase, Generator: "testdata/upgrade-snapshots-pg/generator", Backend: "postgres"}
	envByIdx := []struct{ p, e uint }{{1, 1}, {second.ID, prod2.ID}}
	versions := []int{1, 2, 3, 1, 2}
	for i, nv := range versions {
		pe := envByIdx[i%2]
		val := fmt.Sprintf("snapshot-value-%s-%d-v1", tag, i)
		sn, err := c.CreateSecret(ctx, &core.CreateSecretRequest{Name: fmt.Sprintf("snapshot-secret-%d", i), Value: []byte(val), ProjectID: pe.p, EnvironmentID: pe.e, Type: "generic", CreatedBy: "admin", OwnerID: adminID})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("create secret %d: %v", i, err)
		}
		s := w6Secret{ID: sn.ID, ProjectID: pe.p, Versions: []w6Version{{1, val}}}
		for v := 2; v <= nv; v++ {
			val := fmt.Sprintf("snapshot-value-%s-%d-v%d", tag, i, v)
			if err := w6Rotate(c, ctx, sn.ID, []byte(val), adminID); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("rotate secret %d: %v", i, err)
			}
			s.Versions = append(s.Versions, w6Version{v, val})
		}
		mf.Secrets = append(mf.Secrets, s)
	}
	for i := range 12 {
		one := adminID
		p := uint(1)
		if err := st.LogAuditEvent(ctx, &models.AuditEvent{EventType: "snapshot.seed", UserID: &one, ProjectID: &p, Description: fmt.Sprintf("seed-%d", i)}); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("audit seed: %v", err)
		}
	}

	// The old binary's own verdicts over the base state.
	model, err := pgBuildModel(raw)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("building model: %v", err)
	}
	for _, u := range model.Users {
		for _, p := range ugProbePerms {
			for _, s := range model.Scopes {
				allow, err := c.Authorize(ctx, u, p, core.Scope{ProjectID: s[0], EnvironmentID: s[1]})
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("authorize: %v", err)
				}
				mf.Verdicts = append(mf.Verdicts, w6Verdict{u, p, s[0], s[1], allow})
			}
		}
	}
	w6Close(st)

	script, err := pgSnapshotSQL(raw)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("writing snapshot: %v", err)
	}
	src, err := pgDumpDB(raw)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("dumping source: %v", err)
	}
	_ = raw.Close()

	// Fidelity: replaying the script must recreate the database exactly.
	replayName := name + "_replay"
	w6Exec(t, admin, "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS "+replayName+" WITH (FORCE)")
	w6Exec(t, admin, "CREATE DATABASE "+replayName)
	defer func() { w6Exec(t, admin, "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS "+replayName+" WITH (FORCE)") }()
	rr := w6Open(t, w6DSN(base, replayName))
	if err := pgReplaySnapshot(rr, script); err != nil {
		_ = rr.Close()
		t.Fatalf("replaying snapshot: %v", err)
	}
	got, err := pgDumpDB(rr)
	_ = rr.Close()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("dumping replay: %v", err)
	}
	if string(got) != string(src) {
		t.Fatalf("snapshot is not faithful: %s", w6FirstDiff(string(src), string(got)))
	}

	// The generator model must agree with this release's Authorize on generated
	// states before the snapshot is accepted.
	cfg := ugConfig{Fold: w6Fold}
	probeCount := 0
	seed := []byte{1}
	for i := range w6ModelSeeds {
		t.Logf("model seed %d at %s", i, time.Now().Format("15:04:05"))
		h := sha256.Sum256(seed)
		seed = h[:]
		copyName := fmt.Sprintf("%s_c%d", name, i)
		w6Exec(t, admin, "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS "+copyName+" WITH (FORCE)")
		w6Exec(t, admin, "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = '"+name+"' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()")
		w6Exec(t, admin, "CREATE DATABASE "+copyName+" TEMPLATE "+name)
		cdsn := w6DSN(base, copyName)
		cr := w6Open(t, cdsn)
		if _, err := pgApplyState(cr, seed, cfg); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("seed %d: pgApplyState: %v", i, err)
		}
		m, err := pgBuildModel(cr)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		cst, err := NewStorageFactory().CreateStorage(w6Config(cdsn))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("seed %d: reopening: %v", i, err)
		}
		cc := core.NewKeyorixCore(cst)
		for _, u := range m.Users {
			for _, p := range ugProbePerms {
				for _, s := range m.Scopes {
					// A stride of the probes: each is several round trips over the tunnel.
					// Every probe of the base state above is always checked.
					if probeCount++; probeCount%w6ProbeStride != 0 {
						continue
					}
					mf.ModelProbes++
					got, err := cc.Authorize(ctx, u, p, core.Scope{ProjectID: s[0], EnvironmentID: s[1]})
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatalf("seed %d: authorize: %v", i, err)
					}
					if want := m.Decide(u, p, s[0], s[1]); got != want {
						t.Fatalf("seed %d: model disagrees with %s Authorize u=%d %s %v: model %v, binary %v", i, tag, u, p, s, want, got)
					}
				}
			}
		}
		w6Close(cst)
		_ = cr.Close()
		w6Exec(t, admin, "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS "+copyName+" WITH (FORCE)")
		mf.ModelSeeds++
	}

	if err := os.MkdirAll(out, 0o750); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "snapshot.sql"), []byte(script), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mb, err := json.MarshalIndent(mf, "", " ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "manifest.json"), append(mb, '\n'), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("%s: %d verdicts, %d model probes over %d seeds, faithful snapshot written", tag, len(mf.Verdicts), mf.ModelProbes, mf.ModelSeeds)
}

func w6FirstDiff(a, b string) string {
	al, bl := strings.Split(a, "\n"), strings.Split(b, "\n")
	for i := range max(len(al), len(bl)) {
		var x, y string
		if i < len(al) {
			x = al[i]
		}
		if i < len(bl) {
			y = bl[i]
		}
		if x != y {
			return fmt.Sprintf("line %d: %.200q != %.200q", i, x, y)
		}
	}
	return "same lines"
}
